The '''Tribal Champion's Glaive''' was a type of [[Vibro-glaive/Legends|vibroglaive]]<ref name="Cartel Market" /> produced during the [[Third Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|5.10}}</ref>
